projects.title: Document Forensics
projects.bodyText:
- Tool made with python to detect forgery in images and PDFs
 - Uses image processing algorithms and machine learning to detect any signs of tampering on images and PDFs with near 100% success rate
 - Handwriting detection on printed receipts using a classification model developed from scratch

projects.title: Image and Medical Segmentation
projects.bodyText:
- Image segmentation projects that use deep learning models to isolate areas of an image that are of medical interest
 - Used custom written pytorch computer vision models as well as foundational models such as segment-anything
 - Output results are used by research team

projects.title: Intelligent Document Analysis
projects.bodyText:
- Application made using python that leverages Azure Doc intelligence to efficiently extract key fields of interest from invoices and receipts
 - Custom algorithms on top of doc intelligence for a more tailored output
 - Used by finance team to generate insights

projects.title: Understanding of Data in Images
projects.bodyText:
- Use LLMs and image processing to understand data in images
 - Langchain is used with OpenAI, Bedrock etc to provide multiple options to the user
 - Can generate text summaries of data in graphs, plots, etc

projects.title: Lip Sync - Audio Cloning
projects.bodyText:
- POC to take videos and translate them while keeping the original voice
 - Uses opensource and custom models with techniques such as LipGANs, FaceGans etc for lip syncing the video to a new audio
 - TTS and transcription models are used on the audio side for a complete pipeline

projects.title: Image Translation
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a tool to translate images from one language to another using only image processing techniques
 - Can translate images in a pdf and replace them in place
 - Works on all languages and leverages Google Translate for text translation

projects.title: V2X Robot Communication using LIDAR
projects.bodyText:
- Wrote a custom simulation using ROS2 for robots equipped with LIDAR to communicate with each other on map to avoid collisions
 - Uses ROS2 HUMBLE with python along with Gazebo for simulation
 - Also worked on physical robots - XIAOR-GEEK LIDAR ROBOT

projects.title: AI Avatar Generation
projects.bodyText:
- Leverages Azure AI speech resources and text to speech avatars
 - Python code to invoke model and customize avatar movements
 - Developed for the marketing team

projects.title: AI Contract Negotiator
projects.bodyText:
- Built using LangGraph, Bedrock and Chroma to assist with contract negotiations with clinical trial sites
 - Leverages fine-tuned LLMs to automate negotiation workflows
 - Reduced 12 FTE involved annually and cut negotiation times by 45%

projects.title: ClinChat - Clinical Paper Analysis
projects.bodyText:
- Application to generate summaries and compare multiple IMRAD clinical papers with an interactive chat function
 - Built with ReactJS, AWS ECS, OpenSearch and Azure OpenAI
 - Enables researchers to efficiently analyze and cross-reference clinical literature

projects.title: Medical Legal Review Assistant
projects.bodyText:
- AI-powered tool to review promotional and recruitment material for clinical trials
 - Built with LangChain and OpenSearch, deployed on AWS ECR with Azure Cognitive Services for OCR
 - Reduces review and approval time by 32%

projects.title: TFL to ARDS Dataset Reverse Engineering
projects.bodyText:
- Recreates ARDS datasets from TFLs for clinical trial data to support content generation and scientific publications
 - Uses a custom LLM-based parser alongside an .rtf to .jpg pipeline to process TFL tables
 - Estimated annual savings of $80,000 - $100,000

projects.title: Agentic Document Compliance
projects.bodyText:
- Agentic system with MCP integrations to classify, validate and make recommendations on clinical documents against ALOCA+ standards
 - Built using CrewAI, LangChain and AWS Bedrock, with connections to AWS RDS
 - Saves an estimated 3-4 FTE per year

projects.title: Live Inspections Translation Tool
projects.bodyText:
- Critical tool built in ~1 week to live-translate inspections in Europe
 - Python-based .exe that uses Azure Translate to mirror scribe text from a source document to a target document in real time
 - Automatically detects end of lines and paragraphs to trigger translations seamlessly

projects.title: Calendar Productivity Tool
projects.bodyText:
- Analyzes calendars for the clinical team to surface insights on meetings, attendees and molecule priorities
 - Built with Microsoft Graph API, Python and LLMs
 - Makes actionable recommendations aligned with organizational goals
